subject: SI credit bridge request for CloudScale pilot (marketplace listing track)
messages:
From: Rajesh Kumar <raj@cloudscale-systems.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marketplace Ops <marketplace-ops@cloudscale.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SI-sourced promo credits + 90d pilot extension

Hi Vivek / Camila,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the CloudScale integration looks very promising. We have a handful of enterprise prospects who want to test the end-to-end experience from our Marketplace listing and the SI-delivered onboarding. Two asks from our side: 

- Can Redwood provide a partner-sourced promo voucher (~$12k USD) to cover consumption for a 90-day SI-led pilot (expected start 2027-05-01)?
- If possible, extend the trial window for our referral account by 90 days so the customers can complete their PoCs without hitting quota blocks.

Attached: SOW draft and a short usage projection. We can sign a simple MOU covering co-sell promotion if that helps. We also need to confirm whether voucher-redemptions will show up on the marketplace billing or must flow through our co-sell invoicing.

Would appreciate a quick yes/no and any internal next steps. Our deadline to confirm with the SI is next Wednesday (2027-04-21).

Cheers,
Rajesh Kumar
Head of Partnerships | CloudScale Systems
raj@cloudscale-systems.com

Attachments: SOW-CloudScale-SI-pilot-v1.pdf (pdf), usage-projection.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajesh Kumar <raj@cloudscale-systems.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SI-sourced promo credits + 90d pilot extension

Camila / Priyom / Lauren — looping you in. CloudScale is asking for a partner-sourced voucher (~$12k) to support an SI-led 90-day pilot that will feed into our upcoming marketplace listing review. Key points:

- Pilot start target: ~2027-05-01.
- Expected consumption: see their projection (attached).
- We need to confirm accounting treatment (marketplace voucher vs Redwood credit) and any SLA/usage guardrails.
- Compliance: will this involve customer data flowing through their VPC? (Rajesh, pls confirm)

As the ask is time-sensitive, can we do a conditional approval today if: (a) Priyom signs off on budget and co-sell classification, (b) Camila confirms onboarding resources, and (c) Lauren confirms marketplace listing windows and DocuSign timeline?

If yes, I propose issuing a temporary voucher code (partner_promo_temp_2027) that auto-expires at the end of the 90-day window and is limited to the CloudScale account IDs listed in the SOW. Priyom / Lauren — thoughts?

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SI-sourced promo credits + 90d pilot extension

+1 to moving quickly but with conditions. I can approve up to $12,000 in partner promo credits for a pilot, provided we get the following:

- Confirmation that CloudScale is acting as an SI partner (evidence: signed partner addendum or existing partner record).
- The voucher is single-use per-customer and limited to the customer account IDs in the SOW.
- We capture a brief attestation from the SI that Redwood will be listed as the inference provider in customer-facing collateral.
- Finance will need a short memo noting this is promotional spend tied to marketplace listing (I will file it).

I ran a quick check — this can be allocated out of the partner promo pool (Q2 credits). Recommend issuing code: CLOUDSPARK-APAC-2027 with a 90-day expiry and telemetry tags for the deal (deal:DEAL-3742).

Linking the HubSpot record here: https://hubspot.redwood/deal/3742 and adding a Jira for provisioning: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-1987.

If Camila confirms onboarding capacity, I approve.

— Priyom
Priyom Das
Sr. Manager, Partner Programs | Redwood Inference

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Rajesh Kumar <raj@cloudscale-systems.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: SI-sourced promo credits + 90d pilot extension

Raj — good news. We can provide the partner-sponsored voucher under the conditions Priyom outlined. Next steps: 

1) We will issue voucher code CLOUDSPARK-APAC-2027 (value cap $12,000 USD) — single-use per customer account and expires 90 days after activation. Voucher and redemption instructions attached (voucher-CLOUDSPARK-2027.txt).
2) Please confirm CloudScale signs the partner addendum (I attached a one-page addendum in SOW-CloudScale-SI-pilot-v1.pdf). If you can return a signed copy, we can provision the voucher same-day.
3) I'll open the onboarding slot for 2027-05-03 to 2027-05-17 for the SI delivery team — please confirm the preferred start date.
4) DocuSign link for the addendum: https://www.docusign.com/sign?token=abc123.

On the billing side: this will be recorded as partner promo spend (Finance notified). Metrics and tags: deal=DEAL-3742; provisioning ticket INFRA-1987.

Let us know if the SI requires any special KMS or network requirements; we'll route that to Security after we get the signed addendum.

Thanks and excited to get this into the marketplace.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Partner Solutions | Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.ai
